wine_name: Plantagenet Omrah Pinot Noir, Great Southern

hook.note: Bronze-medal claim is consistent with '2 entries (medals/points)' context; cool-climate descriptors align with Great Southern; no fabricated specifics.

wine_summary.note: Soil descriptions (lateritic gravelly sandy loams, karri loams, granite/gneiss) are plausible regional geology but not verified in ground truth; the ground truth says 'gravelly loam soils' which partially aligns; no fabricated numbers.

terroir_expression.note: Ironstone/woodland edge and specific soil types are reasonable inferences but go beyond verified ground truth; tasting descriptors are speculative but directionally sound for the region.

vinification_summary.note: Ground truth says '10 months in French oak barrels' — this field omits that specific detail and instead hedges with 'enough oak to support the wine'; the parenthetical explanation of extraction feels like filler rather than specificity.

food_pairing.note: Pairings are well-reasoned and specific; no factual claims to contradict; good range from casual to fine dining.

comparable_wines.note: Frankland River and Pemberton are sub-regions of Great Southern / WA so comparisons are reasonable but somewhat circular; Burgundy regional comparison is fair; no specific producer names given which limits usefulness.

style_profile.note: Accurate and concise descriptor set consistent with 100% Pinot Noir from Great Southern; no issues.

cellar_recommendation.note: 3-5 years from a 2011 wine means drinking window already passed by now (2024); storage temperature is a reasonable recommendation but not verified; the advice is sound for the wine's level.

value_assessment.note: Price range AUD $15-25 is fabricated — not in context or ground truth; comparison to De Bortoli and Banrock Station is reasonable positioning but Banrock Station is a much lower tier.

market_position.note: Correctly positions Omrah as a second-label/value tier consistent with ground truth; by-the-glass suggestion is practical and well-targeted.

insider_take.note: Takes a clear position and avoids theater; the earthy-grip-as-feature framing is opinionated and direct; no factual errors but also no unique insider knowledge deployed.

overall_note: Solid voice throughout with no banned words; main correctness gaps are the omission of verified cooperage details in vinification, fabricated price range, and some speculative soil/terroir claims beyond ground truth.
